patterns.pattern: ^([Aa]n agitated ghost) floats up behind you and throttles you with a shred of (?:his|her|its|their) tattered robe\.$
^([Aa] horkval guard) thumps you hard over the head, making your head ring\.$
^([Aa] horkval guard) slashes one of (?:his|her|its|their) upper arms across your torso, razor-sharp, raised scales on the arm cutting you open\.$
^With a powerful flex of (?:his|her|its|their) legs, ([Aa] horkval guard) lunges at you, smashing into you with a painful thwack\.$
